releaseNotes: Added Anime Tracker with AniList search, local watchlist tracking, episode progress, airing schedules, sequels, cover images, and autosaved notes.
Added Settings with startup page, default output folder, date/time format, theme switching, updates, and about sections.
Added light mode and improved global theming for controls, icons, dropdowns, buttons, and scrollbars.
Improved File Converter, Auto Clicker, and Media Downloader layouts, scrolling behavior, and input handling.
Reduced repaint work for the live clock to avoid once-per-second UI stutter.
